title: Phase 1 complete: Grid lifecycle conversion (imperative → declarative AgGridReact)
body:
Phase 1 of TASK-preact-to-react-C-ag-grid complete. All 7 steps (P1-S1 through P1-S7) done.

Artifacts:
- SRC/preact/ui/grid.tsx — Full conversion from imperative agGrid.createGrid() to declarative <AgGridReact>

Key changes:
1. Imports: preact/hooks → react, added AgGridReact + GridApi/GridReadyEvent from ag-grid-community
2. Module singletons: `gridResult: AGridApi` → `_resultGridApi: GridApi` (proper type from ag-grid-community)
3. ResultGrid: useEffect+createGrid → <AgGridReact> with useMemo for gridData, onGridReady for API ref + col state restore
4. PreviewGrid: Same pattern, useMemo for previewRows + columnDefs, all hooks before early returns
5. Lifecycle: No manual create/destroy — React reconciliation handles it
6. Refresh functions: Same exported API, now backed by module-level GridApi refs set via onGridReady
7. Double-RAF hacks: Removed from grid.tsx (app.tsx still has them — out of scope)

Additional fixes:
- class → className (React JSX)
- String style → style objects (React JSX)
- applyColumnState: wrapped array in { state: ..., applyOrder: true } (real AG Grid API vs old custom AGridApi interface)
- Removed unsafe type casts (resetRowHeights/redrawRows are real GridApi methods)
- Extracted DEFAULT_COL_DEF as module-level constant (shared between both grids)

Verification:
- Typecheck: 0 errors in grid.tsx
- Lint: 0 errors in grid.tsx
- Tests: 1045 passed, 3 files failed (pre-existing — rename-modal.tsx and pipeline-arrow.test.tsx still use preact imports, to be converted in Plan B)

Note: ContextMenu and RenameModal are still Preact components (Plan B scope). grid.tsx imports them but they cause transitive test failures for grid-bands.test.ts and band-overlay-e2e.test.ts.

title: Phase 1 complete: auto-preview.ts — debounced store-driven report execution
body:
Phase 1 of TASK-live-chip-table-ui-E-auto-preview complete. Single step — created auto-preview.ts.

File created:
1. SRC/preact/ui/auto-preview.ts (~180 lines) — Module-level singleton with:
   - initAutoPreview(): subscribes to store, filters _ui-only changes via JSON fingerprint comparison (strips _ui key, stringifies rest), guards against double init
   - destroyAutoPreview(): unsubscribes, clears timer, resets _running/_queued
   - schedulePreview(): 400ms debounce timer, clears previous on re-call
   - executePreview() (internal): reentry guard (_running/_queued pattern), hash check via JSON.stringify(buildReportSpecFromState(state)), builds full ReportSpec from state using createReportSpec() as base, calls runReport(), stores result via store.set('result', ...), calls refreshResultGridLayout(), try/catch/finally with queued re-execution

Key implementation choices:
- Used stateFingerprint() helper that destructures out _ui and JSON.stringifies the rest, rather than deep-comparing individual keys
- buildReportSpecFromAppState() fills all aggregation fields (colTotals, subtotalBy, subtotalFns, subtotalGrandTotal, subtotalSpacer, subtotalOnTop, subtotalStrategy) not just the ones explicitly listed in the task
- Cast result as `unknown as Record<string, unknown>` for store.set('result', ...) compatibility with AppState['result'] type
